rows: Dīgha Nikāya 14
suttantapiṭake dīghanikāyo (dutiyo bhāgo) mahāvaggo namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa
Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Dīghanikāyo Mahāvaggapāḷi
